messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Aunty main Zoya ke office se bol rahi hoon. Zoya bohot bimar hai hospital mein admit hai.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Unhein foran operation karna hai, 150,000 deposit chahiye abhi.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Allah! Kaun sa hospital hai beta?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Private hospital hai. Western Union se bhej dein mere cousin ke naam par, pata yeh hai.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Please aunty Zoya ko phone mat karna woh unconscious hai, aur family ko mat batana sharam ki baat hai.
